<?php
/**
 * Template Engine for internationalized document rendering
 * Supports locale-specific regex patterns for text normalization
 */

class LocaleConfig {
    private array $locales;
    
    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $this->locales = json_decode(file_get_contents($configPath), true) ?? $this->getDefaults();
    }
    
    private function getDefaults(): array {
        return [
            'en_US' => [
                'name' => 'English (US)',
                'encoding' => 'UTF-8',
                'regex_flags' => 'mu',  // multiline, unicode
                'decimal_sep' => '.',
                'thousands_sep' => ',',
                'date_format' => 'Y-m-d'
            ],
            'de_DE' => [
                'name' => 'German',
                'encoding' => 'UTF-8', 
                'regex_flags' => 'mu',
                'decimal_sep' => ',',
                'thousands_sep' => '.',
                'date_format' => 'd.m.Y'
            ],
            'ja_JP' => [
                'name' => 'Japanese',
                'encoding' => 'UTF-8',
                'regex_flags' => 'mu', // multiline, unicode
                'decimal_sep' => '.',
                'thousands_sep' => ',',
                'date_format' => 'Y/m/d'
            ]
        ];
    }
    
    public function getLocale(string $locale): array {
        return $this->locales[$locale] ?? $this->locales['en_US'] ?? $this->getDefaults()['en_US'];
    }
    
    public function getRegexFlags(string $locale): string {
        $config = $this->getLocale($locale);
        $flags = $config['regex_flags'] ?? 'mu';
        // Sanitize: only allow safe regex modifiers
        return preg_replace('/[^imsuxADJU]/', '', $flags);
    }
}

class TextNormalizer {
    private LocaleConfig $config;
    private string $locale;
    
    public function __construct(LocaleConfig $config, string $locale) {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->locale = $locale;
    }
    
    /**
     * Apply locale-specific text normalization rules
     * Rules format: array of [pattern, replacement] pairs
     * Uses preg_replace_callback for safety (no /e modifier risk)
     */
    public function normalize(string $text, array $rules): string {
        $flags = $this->config->getRegexFlags($this->locale);
        
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if (!isset($rule['pattern']) || !isset($rule['replacement'])) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $pattern = $rule['pattern'];
            $replacement = $rule['replacement'];
            
            // Validate pattern doesn't contain delimiters
            if (strpos($pattern, '/') !== false) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Build the full regex with locale-appropriate flags
            $fullPattern = '/' . $pattern . '/' . $flags;
            
            // Use preg_replace_callback for safe literal replacement
            $safeReplacement = $replacement;
            $result = preg_replace_callback($fullPattern, function($matches) use ($safeReplacement) {
                // Only perform literal string replacement, no code evaluation
                $output = $safeReplacement;
                // Support backreferences like $1, $2 safely
                for ($i = count($matches) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
                    $output = str_replace('$' . $i, $matches[$i], $output);
                }
                return $output;
            }, $text);
            if ($result !== null) {
                $text = $result;
            }
        }
        
        return $text;
    }
    
    /**
     * Normalize whitespace according to locale rules
     */
    public function normalizeWhitespace(string $text): string {
        $flags = $this->config->getRegexFlags($this->locale);
        $pattern = '/\\s+/' . $flags;
        $result = preg_replace($pattern, ' ', $text);
        return $result ?? $text;
    }
}

class TemplateEngine {
    private TextNormalizer $normalizer;
    private array $variables = [];
    private array $filters = [];
    
    public function __construct(TextNormalizer $normalizer) {
        $this->normalizer = $normalizer;
        $this->initFilters();
    }
    
    private function initFilters(): void {
        $this->filters = [
            'upper' => fn($v) => mb_strtoupper($v),
            'lower' => fn($v) => mb_strtolower($v),
            'trim' => fn($v) => trim($v),
            'escape' => fn($v) => htmlspecialchars($v, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8'),
            'urlencode' => fn($v) => urlencode($v),
            'length' => fn($v) => (string)mb_strlen($v),
            'nl2br' => fn($v) => nl2br(htmlspecialchars($v, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')),
        ];
    }
    
    public function setVariable(string $name, mixed $value): void {
        $this->variables[$name] = $value;
    }
    
    public function setVariables(array $vars): void {
        foreach ($vars as $k => $v) {
            $this->variables[$k] = $v;
        }
    }
    
    public function render(string $template, array $normalizationRules = []): string {
        // First pass: variable interpolation
        $output = preg_replace_callback('/\{\{\s*([\w.]+)(?:\|([\w|]+))?\s*\}\}/', function($matches) {
            $varPath = $matches[1];
            $filterChain = isset($matches[2]) ? explode('|', $matches[2]) : [];
            
            $value = $this->resolveVariable($varPath);
            
            foreach ($filterChain as $filterName) {
                $filterName = trim($filterName);
                if (isset($this->filters[$filterName])) {
                    $value = ($this->filters[$filterName])($value);
                }
            }
            
            return $value;
        }, $template);
        
        // Second pass: apply normalization rules
        if (!empty($normalizationRules)) {
            $output = $this->normalizer->normalize($output, $normalizationRules);
        }
        
        return $output;
    }
    
    private function resolveVariable(string $path): string {
        $parts = explode('.', $path);
        $current = $this->variables;
        
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (is_array($current) && array_key_exists($part, $current)) {
                $current = $current[$part];
            } else {
                return '';
            }
        }
        
        return is_scalar($current) ? (string)$current : json_encode($current);
    }
}

// --- Application Entry Point ---

function loadConfig(string $configFile): LocaleConfig {
    if (file_exists($configFile)) {
        return new LocaleConfig($configFile);
    }
    return new LocaleConfig('/dev/null');
}

function processRequest(array $params): string {
    $locale = $params['locale'] ?? 'en_US';
    $template = $params['template'] ?? 'Hello, {{name}}!';
    $variables = [];
    
    // Parse variables from params  
    foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
        if (str_starts_with($key, 'var_')) {
            $variables[substr($key, 4)] = $value;
        }
    }
    
    // Parse normalization rules from params
    $rules = [];
    if (isset($params['rules']) && is_string($params['rules'])) {
        $decoded = json_decode($params['rules'], true);
        if (is_array($decoded)) {
            $rules = $decoded;
        }
    }
    
    $config = loadConfig(__DIR__ . '/locales.json');
    $normalizer = new TextNormalizer($config, $locale);
    $engine = new TemplateEngine($normalizer);
    $engine->setVariables($variables);
    
    return $engine->render($template, $rules);
}

// CLI mode
if (php_sapi_name() === 'cli') {
    $options = getopt('', ['locale:', 'template:', 'rules:', 'var:']);
    $params = [
        'locale' => $options['locale'] ?? 'en_US',
        'template' => $options['template'] ?? 'Hello, {{name|escape}}!',
    ];
    
    if (isset($options['rules'])) {
        $params['rules'] = $options['rules'];
    }
    
    // Parse --var name=value pairs
    if (isset($options['var'])) {
        $vars = is_array($options['var']) ? $options['var'] : [$options['var']];
        foreach ($vars as $v) {
            $eqPos = strpos($v, '=');
            if ($eqPos !== false) {
                $params['var_' . substr($v, 0, $eqPos)] = substr($v, $eqPos + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    echo processRequest($params) . "\n";
}
